verdict.rationale: Per-user search restriction is a fair axis for a search engine, but the pack has no evidence of scoped or tenant search tokens that embed per-user filters. The only on-topic item is a community request for Algolia-style secured, index-restricted API keys, noted as not yet available at the time. A bare 'Security' heading in the production guide and Cloud dashboard RBAC (team access, not end-user search scoping) do not show the capability.
